failures.reason: pi-poppy's token request (agent.ts, the send() retry after use_dpop_nonce) signs a new client assertion and DPoP proof but resends the caller's Session assertion, so its jti is used twice (session-assertion.jti-reused; Poppy 4.2: a jti is single use). Hidden until now behind the strict mock's typ refusal.
As in N: on use_dpop_nonce pi-poppy resends the same Session assertion, so its jti is used twice (session-assertion.jti-reused).
After the Company ends the Session, pi-poppy renews on 401 invalid_token, gets invalid_session from the token endpoint and throws it instead of starting a new Session (Poppy 4.2).

Reading S2, blamed on the spec: pi-poppy's Session assertion (signSessionAssertion) has no typ "JWT", and it declares S2 any; dpa-mock-strict declares jwt-60s and refuses the assertion with invalid_grant at the first Session. The lenient reference dpa-mock accepts it.

Datalayer's confirm answers an Operation with "expires_at": null; pi-poppy's parseOperation accepts the member absent but not null, so it reports a failure for an operation the Company performed. The Operations extension doesn't say whether optional members may be null.
Datalayer's cancel answers "result": {"summary", "data": null}; pi-poppy's parseOperation rejects result.data: null. The Operations extension doesn't say whether optional members may be null.

Datalayer's TypeScript DeviceSignInClient.poll sends each device token request once and never retries use_dpop_nonce (unlike its Session, code, refresh and revocation requests), so Device Sign-In fails at a Company that requires nonces (Poppy 4.3, RFC 9449 section 8).

Datalayer's Python DeviceSignInClient.poll has no use_dpop_nonce handling (device.py), unlike its Session, code, refresh and revocation requests, so Device Sign-In fails at a Company that requires nonces (Poppy 4.3, RFC 9449 section 8).

Datalayer's TypeScript ConversationClient.stream reconnects at once, with no delay or retry: handling, and throws stream_unavailable after five reconnects that bring nothing new; a Company that closes an idle stream fails the resume at the latest event (Poppy 7.6).

Ilmer is signed-out only, so its OAuth metadata has no authorization_endpoint; poppy-demo's discovery runs new URL(undefined) on it and throws (action_failed).
poppyseed answers revocation with 200 and an empty body (RFC 7009 allows it); the caller JSON.parses it and throws, so signout reports action_failed though the token was revoked.
